chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Ibrahim ibn Abd al-Hamid, from a man who said:

I entered upon Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) and complained to him of a pain in my body. So he said, 'Say, In the Name of Allah, then wipe your hand over it and say, I seek Refuge by the Might of Allah, and I seek Refuge with the Power of Allah, and I seek Refuge with the Majesty of Allah, and I seek Refuge with the Magnificence of Allah, and I seek Refuge with the Hold of Allah, and I seek Refuge with the Messenger of Allah, and I seek Refuge with the Names of Allah, from the evil of what I am cautious of, and from the evil of what I fear upon myself.' You should say it seven times.
He said, 'So I did it, and Allah, Mighty and Majestic, removed the pain from me by it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the supplication for curing pain according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith illustrates the Shia practice of Ruqyah (spiritual healing) through the tactile application of divine names, emphasizing the interplay between physical action and spiritual invocation. The Imam’s instruction to wipe the affected area while reciting seeks refuge in Allah’s might, power, majesty, and greatness reflects a holistic approach to healing that integrates the believer's trust in God's attributes with tangible remedy. This specific supplication underscores the theological principle that healing comes solely from Allah, using His names as a means of seeking protection and relief from affliction.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibrahim Bin Abdul Hameed, from a man who said,

‘I went over to Abu Abdullahasws and I complained to himasws of my pain. So heasws said, ‘Say, ‘In the Name of Allahazwj’, then wipe your hand over it and say, ‘I seek Refuge by the Might of Allahazwj, and I seek Refuge with the Power of Allahazwj, and I seek Refuge with the Majesty of Allahazwj, and I seek Refuge with the Magnificence of Allahazwj, and I seek Refuge with the Hold of Allahazwj, and I seek Refuge with Rasool-Allahsaww, and I seek Refuge with the Names of Allahazwj, from the evil of what I am cautious of, and from the evil of what I fear upon myself’. You should be saying it seven times’.
He (the narrator) said, ‘So I did it, and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Removed the pain by it’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Ibrahim ibn ‘Abd al-Hamid from a man who has said the following:

“Once I went in the presence of abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) and complained to him from a pain that I suffered. The Imam instructed me to say, ‘In the name of Allah, wipe your hand on the painful area and say, “I seek protection through the power of Allah, I seek protection through the glory of Allah, I seek protection through the greatness of Allah, I seek protection through the community of Allah, I seek protection through the Messenger of Allah, I seek protection through the names of Allah, against the evil of that which I avoid and from the evil of that from which I fear for myself,”’ - seven times.
I (the narrator) followed the instruction and Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, removed the pain from me.’”
